## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Checks

- [ ] The change is scoped and readable.
- [ ] Parameterized SQL is used for database inputs.
- [ ] Auth rules are correct for HTML and JSON routes.
- [ ] New fetch calls check non-OK responses and handle 401.
- [ ] Tests were added or updated where behavior changed.
- [ ] `python -m pytest` passes locally.
- [ ] UI changes were checked at mobile width and keyboard navigation.
